source: RELEASE_READINESS.md (ship criteria table + release command gate) cross-referenced with PROJECT_FLIGHT_MASTER_VISUAL_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_v5.0.md section 33 (Final Definition of Done) and section 17.5 (Visual scorecard).

repo_gate.description: RELEASE_READINESS.md's own 'Release command gate' -- the only gate fully verifiable from this repository without a device or a deployed host.

commands.detail: tsc -b && vite build (latest local full run)

repo_gate.gate_verdict: PASS (as of 2026-09-17, against the working tree including uncommitted changes -- see PROJECT_STATE.json for why uncommitted state matters here)
repo_gate.caveat: npm run lint is not part of RELEASE_READINESS.md's release command gate but was run anyway: PASS with zero warnings/errors in the latest local full run.

ship_criteria.exit_condition: New player completes tutorial->hangar->briefing->flight->results->retry/map without a blocked screen.
ship_criteria.required_evidence: Manual smoke test, touch and keyboard.
ship_criteria.reason: No recorded manual smoke test exists in the repo. See TASK_GRAPH.json VS-04.

ship_criteria.exit_condition: Production build succeeds; all automated tests pass; render error offers recovery.
ship_criteria.required_evidence: npm test, npm run build, recovery boundary.
ship_criteria.reason: npm test and npm run build both pass. src/ui/components/AppErrorBoundary.tsx (untracked) is wired into src/main.tsx and provides a recovery boundary -- present but uncommitted (VS-01).

ship_criteria.exit_condition: No known high/critical vulnerability in shipped or desktop dependency tree.
ship_criteria.reason: 0 vulnerabilities found. Note: desktop dependency tree (electron/electron-builder) is itself uncommitted; audited because it is installed in node_modules, but its inclusion in a committed lockfile is pending VS-01.

ship_criteria.exit_condition: Progress survives reload; older save migrates safely.
ship_criteria.reason: save.test.ts passes against fake-indexeddb. Not yet verified on a real browser reload cycle on a production host (PWA-01).

ship_criteria.exit_condition: Installable manifest, service worker, shell cache, branded offline fallback work over HTTPS.
ship_criteria.reason: public/sw.js modified and public/offline.html added, both uncommitted and unverified over real HTTPS. See PWA-01.

ship_criteria.exit_condition: Keyboard path, visible focus, text-size setting, reduced motion, color-blind alternatives; target WCAG 2.2 AA.
ship_criteria.required_evidence: Manual audit plus automated accessibility scan.
ship_criteria.reason: Lighthouse accessibility scan against a served production build scored 1.00 after removing zoom suppression; scan report /tmp/project-flight-lighthouse-a11y-fixed.json. Manual HUD/virtual-stick and assistive-technology audit remains required (A11Y-02).

ship_criteria.exit_condition: iOS Safari and Android Chrome verified in landscape at low/mid/high tier devices.
ship_criteria.reason: No device testing performed; requires physical/cloud device access outside this audit's scope. See QA-01.

ship_criteria.exit_condition: Every advertised mission/upgrade/reward/region completable with starter build or disclosed unlock path.
ship_criteria.reason: src/content/contentValidation.test.ts passes (referential integrity across regions/missions/tech/parts). No human campaign playthrough evidence exists.

spec_final_dod_section_33.note: 20-item checklist from PROJECT_FLIGHT_MASTER_VISUAL_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_v5.0.md section 33, read in full. This audit did not check any box -- these require visual/device review this pass could not perform. Listed here so TASK_GRAPH/RISK_REGISTER can be traced back to a specific spec gate rather than an invented one.

flagged_items_with_repo_evidence.item: no existen placeholder visibles en shipping build
flagged_items_with_repo_evidence.repo_signal: 333 of 361 GLB assets are unreferenced by any runtime code path (see ASSET_PROVENANCE.json) -- not 'visible placeholders' in the sense the spec means (nothing broken renders on screen), but they are unused production art shipping inert in public/. Worth a deliberate read of this DoD line against that fact.

spec section 15.6 (LOD) exists by TOC; no LOD system was found referenced from src/render during this audit's targeted greps. Flagged as unknown, not asserted absent -- a full LOD implementation search was out of scope for this pass.

flagged_items_with_repo_evidence.item: ningún asset hero depende de IP no autorizada
flagged_items_with_repo_evidence.repo_signal: public/assets/models/README.md asserts original geometry; LEGAL-03 tracks the formal sign-off this claim still needs.

visual_scorecard_17_5.note: Spec section 17.5: score each dimension PASS/REVISE, not 1-10; any REVISE blocks final status. This audit has no visual-QA capability (no rendering/screenshot review performed), so every dimension is UNSCORED here, not defaulted to PASS.
visual_scorecard_17_5.status: UNSCORED -- requires human visual QA pass, see ASSET-03/QA-02
